Class AbstractOptionsProvider

java.lang.Object
org.apache.rat.test.AbstractOptionsProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ArgumentsProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractConfigurationOptionsProvider
public abstract class AbstractOptionsProvider extends Object implements org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ArgumentsProvider
A list of methods that an OptionsProvider in a test case must support. Use of this interface ensures consistent testing across the UIs. Each method tests an option from OptionCollection that must be implemented in the UI. Each method in this interface tests an Option in OptionCollection.

      protected abstract ReportConfiguration generateConfig(List<org.apache.commons.lang3.tuple.Pair<org.apache.commons.cli.Option, String[]>> args) throws IOException
      Create the report configuration from the argument pairs. There must be at least one arg. It may be ImmutablePair.nullPair().
